definitions: A popular multi-player board game designed by Klaus Teuber, first published in Germany in 1995.
A strategy game where players collect resources (brick, lumber, wool, grain, ore) to build roads, settlements, and cities on a hexagonal board representing the island of Catan.
examples: We played Settlers of Catan all night.
Settlers of Catan is known for its trading mechanics.
The new expansion for Settlers of Catan adds sea travel.
